subject.title: fix(qa-lab): unref detached qa cli child and detach stdio listeners

question: Should QA Lab retain post-close stdout/stderr listener detachment as a supported lifecycle invariant even though the controlled pre-change comparison found no observable retention or hang?
rationale: The code is mechanically narrow, but no source-level contract or observed failure establishes that deterministic listener removal is worth maintaining; this is a policy choice that automated review cannot safely make.

options.title: Drop the speculative cleanup
options.body: Close or withdraw the PR because current behavior already exits cleanly and no user-visible regression has been demonstrated.

options.title: Adopt an explicit lifecycle invariant
options.body: Retain the change only if a QA Lab owner wants listener removal at close as a deliberate contract and accepts the added test/maintenance surface.
